# Let your customers sell for you, and keep the affiliate ledger in your own account.

> Run an affiliate or referral program on your own Stripe account: tracking link, recurring commissions, refund clawbacks, payout CSV. Plan what a program will cost you in your browser, then deploy the source-available server. Free, FSL-1.1-MIT, no revenue share.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
